messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions, MEDIA, COMMUNICATION AND LANGUAGE, Working conditions, and Health care services and policies in Germany during the 2020s, matching this research need: Representative German population survey data on COVID-19 attitudes and behaviors: infection worries, perceived information, evaluations of government containment measures, work-from-home status, and demographics including region, party preference, and survey weights.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS COVID-19 Snapshot Monitoring COSMO Germany dataset worries information government measures home office party preference weights
